facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving. Keep them off for the whole run.
facts.freeroam: Free roam continues after the story ends, so nothing except one meditation is missable.
facts.replay: No mission replay — keep a save at the start and end of each chapter. 15 manual slots + 1 autosave.

sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies

stages.body: Play the story and do the optional missions as they appear — 100 of them count toward 100% completion. While you play, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 of 277 base models) and study animals with binoculars (100 of 255). Work on the side strands early so their trophies land naturally.
focus: Finish all 5 chapters and the final mission
Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house right after Down to Earth — it is the one trophy that may be missable
Scan 200 vehicles and study 100 animals as you travel
Start the stranger questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret)
stages.title: Story and optional missions

stages.body: After the story, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is friendlier than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The parts that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
focus: 300 stunts (250 pops the Cunning Stunts trophy)
All robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges and drone races
100 optional missions, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 15 of 18 meditations
stages.title: 100% completion and challenges

stages.body: Finish the stranger mission strands and sweep up whatever is left — the last collectibles, the odd combat trophies, the money trophies and the five trophies whose method is still unconfirmed. The platinum pops with the last one.
focus: Final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret
Money trophies: laundering, spending, garages, Scooter Bros
The five unconfirmed-method trophies as the community pins them down
